name: James M. Ashley and Thomas W.L. Ashley U.S. Courthouse (1932, James A. Wetmore), 1716 Spielbusch Ave
refs: refs/w8000054723/00 (Exterior, U.S. Courthouse, Toledo, Ohio, Carol M. Highsmith / Library of Congress via Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Neoclassical in limestone: low basement storey, rusticated ground floor with round-arched windows, two upper storeys behind a giant order of Corinthian columns/pilasters, entablature with a balustraded attic, central pedimented portico facing Spielbusch Ave, green copper hipped roof behind the parapet.
